title: Models, workflows, or agents?
description: Choosing the right AI architecture starts with your business needs. A whitepaper I co-authored with Celine Wong.
paragraphs: Proud to share this whitepaper I co-authored with Celine Wong on choosing the right AI architecture for your business needs.
After working with clients across APAC, I've seen how the Model vs. Workflow vs. Agent decision impacts everything from implementation speed to ROI.
Check out our practical framework and real case studies.
